title: The associated graded of a finite completed module is generated in degree zero
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $\widehat A=\varprojlim_{r\ge1}A/I^r$ its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $\widehat A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Write $I^nM=(I\widehat A)^nM$, with $I^0M=M$. Define the graded ring $B=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^n/I^{n+1}$, with unit $1\bmod I$ in degree zero and multiplication $(a\bmod I^{n+1})(b\bmod I^{m+1})=ab\bmod I^{n+m+1}$, and the graded $B$-module $G=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^nM/I^{n+1}M$, whose action on homogeneous elements is $(a\bmod I^{m+1})(x\bmod I^{n+1}M)=ax\bmod I^{m+n+1}M$. Here direct sums consist of tuples of finite support, with componentwise addition and the displayed products extended distributively. Then $M/IM$ is a finitely generated $A/I$-module, and, for every finite family $\bar x_1,\ldots,\bar x_t$ generating $M/IM$ over $A/I$, these elements, placed in degree zero, generate $G$ over $B$. Explicitly, for every $n\ge0$ and $y\in I^nM$, and any lifts $x_j\in M$ of $\bar x_j$, there exist $a_1,\ldots,a_t\in I^n$ such that $y-\sum_{j=1}^ta_jx_j\in I^{n+1}M$.
